chat.settings.help.always_show_sidebar_o: Always keep the sidebar visible on desktop devices, rather than having it automatically hide.
chat.settings.help.api_key: Configure la clave de API si está utilizando la opción --api-key para el servidor.
chat.settings.help.ask_for_title_confirm: Before automatically changing the conversation title while editing the first message, request confirmation from the user.
chat.settings.help.auto_show_sidebar_on_: Automatically display the sidebar when a new chat is started. Disable this option to keep the sidebar hidden until you click to open it.
chat.settings.help.backend_sampling: Enable backend-based sampling. When enabled, supported samplers will run on the accelerator for faster performance.
chat.settings.help.copy_text_attachments: When copying a message containing text attachments, combine the attachments into a single, plain text string rather than using a special format that would allow them to be pasted back as separate attachments.
chat.settings.help.custom_json: Parámetros JSON personalizados para enviar a la API. Deben tener un formato JSON válido.
chat.settings.help.disable_auto_scroll: Disable automatic scrolling as new messages arrive, allowing you to manually control the visible area of the screen.
chat.settings.help.dry_allowed_length: DRY sampling minimizes redundancy in generated text, even with extensive input. This parameter defines the maximum length permitted for DRY sampling.
chat.settings.help.dry_base: DRY örnekleme, uzun metinlerde bile üretilen metindeki tekrarları azaltır. Bu parametre, DRY örnekleme için temel değeri ayarlar.
chat.settings.help.dry_multiplier: DRY örnekleme, uzun metinlerde bile üretilen metindeki tekrarları azaltır. Bu parametre, DRY örnekleme çarpanını ayarlar.
chat.settings.help.dry_penalty_last_n: DRY sampling minimizes redundancy in generated text, even with extensive input. This parameter defines the repetition penalty applied to the final *n* tokens.
chat.settings.help.dynamic_temperature_e: Add-on for the temperature sampling method. Refines the probability distribution by prioritizing the most likely token.
chat.settings.help.dynamic_temperature_r: Add-on for the temperature sampling method. It expands the range of dynamic temperatures by adjusting probabilities based on token entropy.
chat.settings.help.enable_continue_gener: Enable the “Continue” button for assistant responses. Currently supported only for models that do not utilize reasoning capabilities.
chat.settings.help.endpoint: Choose Open Responses (recommended) or Chat Completions (legacy).
chat.settings.help.frequency_penalty: Limits tokens based on their frequency in the generated text.
chat.settings.help.keep_stats_visible: Keep processing statistics displayed after generation is complete.
chat.settings.help.max_tokens: The maximum number of tokens per output. Use -1 to indicate no limit.
chat.settings.help.min_p: Limita los tokens basándose en la probabilidad mínima que un token debe tener para ser considerado, en relación con la probabilidad del token más probable.
chat.settings.help.parse_pdf_as_image: Process PDFs by rendering them as images rather than extracting text. The system will automatically revert to text-based processing when used with models that do not support image input.
chat.settings.help.paste_long_text_to_fi: When a large amount of text is pasted, it will be saved as a file. You can adjust the maximum file size by changing the value of this setting. A value of 0 disables this feature.
chat.settings.help.presence_penalty: Limits tokens depending on whether they are present in the generated output.
chat.settings.help.py_interpreter_enable: Enable the Python interpreter using Pyodide. This allows you to run Python code within markdown code blocks.
chat.settings.help.render_user_content_a: Render user messages using markdown formatting in the chat.
chat.settings.help.repeat_last_n: Number of previous tokens to consider when penalizing repetition.
chat.settings.help.repeat_penalty: Regulates the repetition of sequences of tokens within the generated text.
chat.settings.help.samplers: The order in which sampling methods are applied, in a simplified manner. The default order is: “top_k; typical_p; top_p; minimum_p; temperature”. This translates to: top_k → typical_p → top_p → minimum_p → temperature.
chat.settings.help.show_message_stats: Display generation statistics (tokens/second, token count, duration) under each assistant message.
chat.settings.help.show_microphone_on_em: When the text area is empty for models that support audio input, automatically display the microphone button instead of the send button.
chat.settings.help.show_raw_llm_output: Display the unprocessed LLM output, without any post-processing or formatting, to allow for examination of the streaming behavior across various models.
chat.settings.help.show_system_message: Afficher le message système en haut de chaque conversation.
chat.settings.help.show_thought_in_progr: By default, elaborate on your reasoning when generating responses.
chat.settings.help.show_tool_calls: Display tool call labels and payloads from Harmony-compatible `delta.tool_calls` data below the assistant’s messages.
chat.settings.help.system_message: The initial prompt that sets the model’s behavior.
chat.settings.help.temperature: Determina el grado de aleatoriedad del texto generado al influir en la distribución de probabilidad de los tokens de salida. Un valor más alto genera resultados más aleatorios, mientras que un valor más bajo produce resultados más predecibles.
chat.settings.help.theme: Select the interface color scheme. You may choose between System (which adapts to your device’s settings), Light, or Dark.
chat.settings.help.top_p: Limit tokens to those whose combined cumulative probability reaches at least p.
chat.settings.help.typical_p: Sorts and limits tokens based on the difference between log-probability and entropy.
chat.settings.help.xtc_probability: XTC sampler cuts out top tokens; this parameter controls the probability of cutting tokens. Setting it to 0 disables XTC.
chat.settings.help.xtc_threshold: XTC sampler removes the most probable tokens; this parameter controls the probability threshold for removing a token.
